data.body: Error sweep #6 dedup evidence (window 2026-09-01T11:58:00-07:00..2026-09-02T10:00:00-07:00 / 2026-09-01T18:58:00Z..2026-09-02T17:00:00Z): CloudWatch in us-east-1 acct 896586841071 showed the known root-disk/Gerrit-offline incident facets: `rebar-root-disk-pressure` flapped OK->ALARM 8 times, `rebar-gerrit-gate-down` fired at 2026-09-01 15:42 PDT and again at 2026-09-02 02:05 PDT before recovering 07:12 PDT, and `rebar-autodeploy-errors` returned to ALARM at 07:28 PDT on deploy_errors datapoints during/after host recovery. GitHub Actions also showed 27 outage/reachability failures: Mirror Guard fetch TLS handshake timeouts (`_ssl.c:993`) and Gerrit Verified Gate `HTTP 504` ticket-resolution failures while Gerrit was down/unreachable. Per sweep instruction, all disk-pressure / host-down / alarm-missing-data / metrics-publisher-gap / reachability facets are deduped here; no new outage-facet tickets filed.
